organic_growth.rate_effect_note: Restated continuing-operations basis from AR 2021 five-year table (driven by key accounts incl. Deutsche Telekom launch). Originally reported group figure differs (pre-divestment perimeter) - not retrieved.
AR 2021 five-year table (restated) -6.6%; AR 2020 originally reported -6.5% with revenue DKK69.8bn, -10.1%.
Operating margin 4.9% (5.0% excl. IAS 29). Includes US hurricane response work in Q4-24.

Revenue DKK84,684m. Building blocks (AR chart, approximate): price increases ~4.5pt, volume growth ~1pt, net contract wins ~-1pt ('ended negative around 1%-point'), projects/above-base ~0. FX & other -3.9% incl. Turkish hyperinflation -0.9pt. By region organic: Northern Europe 3%, Central & Southern Europe 10%, Asia & Pacific 7%, Americas -14% (deliberate 2024 exits + hurricane comparator). Operating margin 5.0% excl. IAS 29. Retention 94%.
organic_growth.term_used: organic growth (price increases + volume + net contract wins + projects/above-base)

latest_interim.note: Q3-26 organic 6.8% (Q3-25 4.9%); 9M-26 7.7%; drivers price increases, contract wins, volume growth with existing customers and projects/above-base. 'Net new wins and volume growth contributing 2%' to Q3 organic -> price/other ~4.8pt is derived (INFERENCE). Retention 95% LTM; four new contracts >DKK100m p.a. since H1; three key-account contracts expired and not renewed in 2026, all other 2026 renewals extended. 2026 outlook (raised 19-May-2026, reaffirmed 4-Nov-2026): organic >6%, operating margin ~5.25%, FCF >DKK3.1bn (TARGET; original Feb-2026: organic >5%, margin >5%, FCF >DKK2.5bn).

claim_checks.claim: Deutsche Telekom contract dispute / arbitration pending
claim_checks.finding: Resolved: company announcement No. 33/2026 (19-May-2026) - settlement agreement over the contractual disagreements and extension/amendment of the DT partnership until end-2035. Same day ISS raised 2026 outlook. Financial terms not disclosed in the announcement text read. DT contract is not a loss.

Operating margin (excl. IAS 29) 2.5% (21) -> 4.0% (22) -> 4.3% (23) -> 5.0% (24) -> 5.0% (25); 2026 guide ~5.25%. New mid-term targets (CMD 14-Sep-2026, replacing Nov-2022 targets): organic growth >5% p.a. average 2026-28, operating margin 5.5-6.0% in 2028, cash conversion >60% (TARGET); like-for-like (volume + net wins) to contribute more and price less vs 2026.

2025: net contract wins c.-1pt of organic growth from contract losses and deliberate exits during 2024 (especially Americas: Americas organic -14%, revenue -18%); two contracts reduced in scope and one lost (qual). 2026: three key-account contracts expired and not renewed; retention 95% LTM.
